# ADR-3052: A05: Security header required key for HTTP profile 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing headers weaken browser isolation.

## Decision

Edge configuration SHALL include a security header required key for HTTP profile 4 (A05-4).

## Consequences

Header baselines cover CSP frame options and referrer.
